recommendation: Provide medication support services for diabetes patients
implementation_steps: Perform medication reconciliation to identify discrepancies
Assist with refill coordination to ensure medication continuity
Identify adherence barriers through patient interviews and refill history analysis
Facilitate communication between patients and pharmacists
Help with insurance or medication access issues
evidence_summary: Pharmacy technician interventions supporting medication access and adherence have been shown to improve medication continuity and reduce gaps in therapy for patients with diabetes, particularly when integrated into comprehensive pharmacy-based diabetes management programs.
citation: Care Management Processes Important for High-Quality Diabetes Care
